description: This file defines the internal class `SiloMetadataSystemTarget` which implements interfaces `ISiloMetadataSystemTarget` and `ILifecycleParticipant<ISiloLifecycle>`. It manages silo metadata retrieval and participates in the silo lifecycle, encapsulating a `SiloMetadata` object.

classes.name: SiloMetadataSystemTarget
classes.description: A sealed internal class that provides access to silo metadata and participates in the silo lifecycle.

methods.name: GetSiloMetadata
methods.description: Returns the current silo metadata encapsulated within a completed Task.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Implements lifecycle participation, but does not perform actions during lifecycle stages.
